mapper.select: SELECT `order`.*,movie.name moviename,movie.id movieid FROM `order` JOIN showtimes on showtimes.id=`order`.showtimes_id JOIN movie on movie.id=showtimes.movie_id where user_id=#{id}

SELECT c.*,h.hall_name,m.`name` movieName ,m.banner,s.showdate,s.showtime ,o.*,s.seat seat from `order` o ,showtimes s ,cinema c,movie m ,hall h where o.order_id=#{orderId} AND o.showtimes_id =s.id and m.id=s.movie_id and h.id=s.hall_id and c.id=s.cinema_id ;
